title: Machine Learning Research Engineer
text:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.
Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.
We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.
Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.
As a Machine Learning Research Engineer at Orbital, you will architect cutting-edge AI systems for the multi-scale design of physical technologies. When we say multi-scale, we mean it: we build world-class foundation models for simulating both the microscopic motion of atoms and the macroscopic flow of liquids in 1GW data centers. We then co-design across these different scales using the ingenuity of our scientists and engineers, augmented with best-in-class domain agents.
In this role you will set exceptionally high technical standards and drive projects from prototype through to production deployment. First and foremost, we want to work with someone with a love of craftsmanship, continual learning, and building systems that scale. We also value low ego, and a genuine passion for using AI to solve major global industrial technology challenges.
Key Responsibilities
Set the technical bar and ensure engineering excellence
- Establish and maintain exceptionally high standards for code quality, system architecture and ML research and engineering practices through hands-on coding and technical review
- Design robust, well-engineered systems that others can build upon, balancing research velocity with production requirements
- Drive technical decisions on model selection, training approaches and deployment strategies
Deliver high-impact AI projects across diverse domains
- Develop and deploy AI solutions across the entire technology development pipeline- computational chemistry simulations, agentic workflows and beyond
- Rapidly upskill in new technical areas through close collaboration with domain experts (no prior chemistry or materials experience required)
- Demonstrate strong implementation skills through hands-on development, contributing significantly to the codebase
- Balance research rigour with pragmatic engineering to deliver production-ready systems at scale
Push the frontier of ML research
- Design and implement novel ML architectures for complex scientific domains, with work that meets publication standards at top-tier conferences
- Drive research projects from conception through to deployment, showing initiative and technical depth
- Engage continuously with the latest ML literature, staying current with developments in foundation models, generative AI and scientific machine learning
What We're Looking For
- Significant software engineering and ML experience, with depth in training, evaluating and deploying AI models - demonstrated through industry work
- Proven experience training, evaluating and productionising AI models at scale, with deep understanding of the full ML lifecycle from research to deployment
- Strong engineering fundamentals with the ability to write high-quality, maintainable code and architect robust systems
- A strong ability to reason about algorithms, system design, linear algebra, probabilistic concepts and ML engineering trade-offs
- An ability to debug complex machine learning systems through meticulous attention to detail, testing of edge cases and carefully selected ablations
- A genuine interest in building AI systems that enable breakthrough scientific and industrial applications
- Upon reading Hamming's You and Your Research, you resonate with quotes such as:
- "Yes, I would like to do first-class work"
- "You should do your job in such a fashion that others can build on top of it, so they will indeed say, 'Yes, I've stood on so and so's shoulders and I saw further.'"
- "Instead of attacking isolated problems, I made the resolution that I would never again solve an isolated problem except as characteristic of a class"
Bonus: Experience with physics-informed or chemistry-focused AI applications. Experience building or fine-tuning large language models. Experience with agent-based systems, tool use or agentic workflows. Contributions to open-source ML projects or published research.
Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Orbital's AI software platform, CurieOS, is used by scientists and engineers to design and build products serving critical industries. Powering this software are our world leading AI models in advanced materials, hardware engineering and simulation.
As a Backend Engineer at Orbital you will design, build and operate the core systems powering CurieOS. You will work across the full backend stack: APIs, data pipelines, graph databases, event-driven architectures and the infrastructure that connects our AI models to the tools our scientists and engineers use daily. An example of a feature you might build is a unified context graph across materials, engineering and manufacturing data for our AI agents.
First and foremost, we want to work with someone with a love of craftsmanship, continual learning and building systems that scale.
Key Responsibilities
Build and operate core backend systems
- Design and implement APIs, services and data pipelines that power CurieOS, with a focus on reliability, performance and clean abstractions
- Build and maintain integrations between our AI models, scientific tools and internal workflows
- Own the full lifecycle of backend features from design through deployment, monitoring and iteration
Drive engineering quality
- Write well-tested, maintainable code and contribute to a culture of high engineering standards through code review, documentation and technical discussion
- Improve system observability, reliability and performance — instrument, monitor and optimise the systems you build
- Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance speed of delivery with long-term maintainability
Collaborate across the team
- Work closely with ML researchers, product engineers and domain experts (materials scientists, hardware engineers) to understand their needs and translate them into robust backend solutions
- Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape the technical direction of the platform
- Share knowledge, mentor peers and help establish best practices as the team grows
What We’re Looking For
- Backend engineering experience with strong programming skills
- Proven experience designing, building and operating backend systems in production — APIs, data pipelines, event-driven architectures or similar
- Strong fundamentals in at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Rust, Java/Kotlin) and comfort working across the stack when needed
- Experience with databases (relational and/or graph), message queues, caching layers and cloud infrastructure
- A track record of shipping and iterating on software that real users depend on, with a strong sense of what makes systems reliable and maintainable
- The ability to reason about system design, data modelling and engineering trade-offs — and to communicate these effectively
- An ability to debug complex distributed systems through meticulous attention to detail, structured investigation and carefully chosen instrumentation
- A genuine interest in building software that enables breakthrough scientific and industrial applications
- Upon reading Hamming's You and Your Research, you resonate with quotes such as:
- "Yes, I would like to do first-class work"
- "You should do your job in such a fashion that others can build on top of it, so they will indeed say, 'Yes, I've stood on so and so's shoulders and I saw further.'"
- "Instead of attacking isolated problems, I made the resolution that I would never again solve an isolated problem except as characteristic of a class"
Bonus : Previous experience working in an AI/ML environment, familiarity with the workflows, tooling and pace of AI teams is a real advantage. Experience with graph databases, knowledge graphs or scientific data platforms. Experience with infrastructure-as-code, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes) or CI/CD pipelines.
Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Test Engineer
text:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.
Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.
We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.
Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.
Role Overview
You'll own the day-to-day operation of Orbital's next-generation Direct-to-Chip test rigs — running the tests, troubleshooting the hardware, and turning raw rig output into data the engineering team can act on. Starting with the final design of our tray-level test rig, you'll take it through component selection, build and commissioning, then do it again with a full rack-scale validation unit..
Key Responsibilities
Test Rig Operation
- Lead day-to-day operation of our tray and rack level engineering test and validation rigs
- Plan, set up and execute test campaigns against engineering requirements
- Troubleshoot rig faults and drive them to resolution
Data Review and Analysis
- Carry out preliminary review of test data for quality and validity
- Feed clean, well-structured data into our analysis pipelines
- Report findings back to the engineering team and flag anomalies early
- Propose next steps to drive system efficiency
Rig design, Build and Commissioning
- Contribute to the final design of tray and rack level test rigs
- Size, identify and procure key rig components, managing suppliers and lead times
- Build and commission rigs, including leak checks and function testing
Instrumentation and Electrical
- Install and wire thermocouples, sensors and signal instrumentation
- Support mechanical and electrical builds, including control panels, under the guidance of our mechanical and electrical leads
- Verify sensor calibration and signal integrity before test
What We’re Looking For
- Experience operating test rigs or lab hardware, ideally in a thermal, fluids or electronics cooling context
- Confident with data — able to spot bad readings, sanity-check results and structure output for downstream analysis
- Comfortable with low-voltage wiring, thermocouples and sensor signals
- Practical troubleshooter who works the problem on the rig rather than from a desk
- Able to size and specify components and see procurement through to delivery
- Hands-on capability with 3D printers, CNC or workshop tooling is a genuine bonus
Why Join Orbital?
- Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital as we grow
- Flexible and generous paid time off
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan
- Regular company offsites
- The experience of working in a cutting-edge organisation dedicated to a better future
Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Orbital's AI software platform, CurieOS, is used by scientists and engineers to design and build products serving critical industries. Powering this software are our world leading AI models in advanced materials, hardware engineering and simulation.
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Orbital you will deliver CurieOS into customer environments hands-on, writing production code, designing architectures, building integrations and solving problems across the full breadth of industrial R&D. You will embed with customer teams, translate ambiguous high-value problems into working systems, and build solutions that become part of how their scientists and engineers work day-to-day.
First and foremost, we want to work with someone with a love of craftsmanship, continual learning and building systems that scale.

Deliver deployments hands-on, across the breadth of industrial R&D
- Deliver complex customer deployments hands-on, writing production code, designing architectures, building integrations and debugging issues across CurieOS and customer systems

- Codify successful approaches into reusable integration patterns, tooling and playbooks so every engagement makes the next one faster
- Feed field signal to the platform engineering team to shape the CurieOS roadmap
What We’re Looking For
- Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of independently building, shipping and operating production software
- A track record of succeeding in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where requirements evolve through direct iteration with users
- The ability to move fluidly between conversations with customer scientists and engineers and deep technical implementation work

title: Communications Lead
text:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.
Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.
We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.
Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.
Role Overview
We're hiring a Communications Lead to define how Orbital Industries is understood in the market - and to build the communications motion that makes that understanding stick.
This is a category-creation brief. You'll articulate what the AI Industrial is, why CurieOS matters, and how Orbital Industries' full-lifecycle approach (materials, engineering, hardware) represents something genuinely new. You'll translate deep technical work - across AI, materials science, and hardware engineering - into clear, distinctive, high-quality communication that builds authority with investors, technical buyers, talent, and the broader market.
Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.
Key Responsibilities
Communications Strategy and Brand Voice
- Define and own Orbital Industries' external communications strategy — how we are positioned, perceived, and understood in the market
- Build and enforce consistency in brand voice across all external channels: website, social, events, collateral, press
- Set the messaging framework for CurieOS and its three pillars (Materials, Deployment, Hardware), ensuring our full-lifecycle positioning is sharp and differentiated
- Write strong creative and messaging briefs for design, video, and campaign work — giving the GTM team clear strategic direction to execute against
- Ensure a clean separation between Orbital Industries (brand authority, category definition) and Orbital IT (commercial, customer-facing) in how we communicate externally
Stakeholder messaging
- Work closely with the CFO and founders to ensure investor messaging reflects Orbital Industries' positioning as the AI Industrial category leader, not just a product company
- Translate technical milestones (CurieOS releases, customer deployments, materials breakthroughs) into compelling narratives
Content and copy
- Own long-form writing, thought leadership, website messaging, investor content, and campaign assets - from strategy through to production
- Produce content that makes Orbital Industries' work in AI, materials science and hardware engineering accessible without losing credibility or nuance — you know the difference between simplifying and dumbing down
- Develop and maintain CurieOS content across its three pillars: materials discovery, deployment engineering, and hardware product development
- Use LLMs and modern tools to work efficiently while maintaining high editorial standards
Social Media Strategy
- Own organic social strategy: voice, editorial calendar, content direction and output quality
- Build Orbital Industries' social presence into a distinctive point of view, not just a broadcast channel — the GTM team handles day-to-day posting and scheduling
- Track developments across AI infrastructure and adjacent industries to keep content timely and credible
- Partner with the GTM Lead to align organic and paid social messaging
Website messaging
- Own website copy and landing-page messaging, ensuring it is sharp, current and aligned to business priorities
- Work closely with the GTM team on copy for campaign landing pages — you own the message, they own the conversion optimisation and testing cycle
Press and Media
- Develop Orbital Industries' press function - strengthening media relationships, identifying opportunities, and positioning the company for coverage that reinforces our authority in the AI Industrial category
- Amplify founder positioning for external audiences, interviews, speaking engagements and media appearances
- Manage freelance press support and scale the function as the company grows
What We're Looking For
- Significant leadership experience in communications, content, editorial or brand storytelling — ideally in a technical, deep-tech or science-adjacent environment. Experience with investor communications or fundraising narratives is a strong plus
- An excellent writer with strong editorial taste and clear judgement; your portfolio should demonstrate range across long-form, short-form and messaging work
- Deep curiosity about AI, science, engineering or technical products — you follow these spaces because you're genuinely interested, not because it's your job
- The ability to make technical ideas accessible without losing credibility or nuance
- Comfortable owning both strategy and execution — you can set the direction, produce the work, and build the systems that maintain quality without you touching every piece
- Experience building or significantly expanding a communications function — you should find creating something from scratch exciting, not uncomfortable
- High standards for writing, messaging, and brand consistency — you notice when things drift and you fix them before they compound
- Strong collaborative instincts — you'll work closely with technical founders, engineers, a GTM Lead, a design function. You need to influence without owning every channel
- Experience briefing and managing creative work: design, video, freelance writers, press agencies
- Science degree or background is preferred
Why Join Orbital Industries?
- Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital Industries as we grow
- Flexible and generous paid time off
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan
- Regular company offsites to the USA and beyond
- The chance to define the narrative for a new category — the AI Industrial — at a company where communications is a strategic function, not a support one
Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
